segments.name: Biotechnology
segments.description: A clinical-stage biotechnology company using AI and machine learning to develop precision antibody therapeutics for obesity, cardiometabolic and cardiopulmonary diseases.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one reportable segment, which is that of a biotechnology company leveraging AI and ML for the development of hard-to-drug precision antibodies.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from services provided to research collaborators.
revenueModel.evidence: During the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, the Company reported revenue for services provided to one research collaborator.
